name: Global Illumination Rendering with Gaussian Surfels
aliases: Forward Global Illumination with Gaussian Surfels
definition: A forward rendering model for global illumination using Gaussian surfels, derived from the rendering equation, assuming non-overlapping kernels to solve the system using weighted residual form.
summary: Global Illumination Rendering with Gaussian Surfels models indirect light transport by treating light sources as special kernels, enabling accurate geometry reconstruction in scenes with rich inter-reflections.
